title: Worst experience I could ever have imagined. I'm very disappointed.
text:
I ordered 2 $100 Visa gift cards to be delivered to my sons in a different state for their birthdays. I ordered and paid in full with plenty of time for the cards to arrive for their birthdays. The first delivery was the opened packaging for the Visa card with no card in it sealed in an Amazon box. Then a few days later another card arrived for him. I have not confirmed with him if the full $100 balance is on it or if it's useable. Needless to say he didn't get the card until after his birthday.

The card I bought for my other son was also a $100 Visa Gift Card and it was to be shipped to the same address. It was supposed to arrive on his birthday (February 28th) and here we are, March 9th and it still has not even shipped. I called customer service last week and they told me the order could not be cancelled and that I should wait until the 9th before I try to cancel or re-order.

I also ordered these little metal wallet cards with greeting card like messages for both boys at the same time I ordered the Visa cards. They have both received these message cards and I am confused at why this is so difficult. How can we be a week and 2 days form when this was supposed to be delivered, and it still has not even shipped? And my orders page says it will be delivered today by 10pm, but it also shows that it has not yet shipped.

This has created a very difficult and stressful situation for me as my ex likes to tell the boys that I'm a bad guy and now they think I lied about sending them gifts. A $10 gift card from Amazon won't fix it at this point. I've been a Prime member for at least 10 years. I am Amazon loyal, all of my smart devices, tablets, streaming devices everything is Amazon. I even have Alexa in my car. It seems like lately I'm having issues like this. I'm considering using Insta-cart or Door Dash for my delivery needs. Or maybe I'll just join Wal-Mart's version of Prime.

title: It was never delivered
text:
I ordered a $100 gift card for a friend's wedding gift. It was a destination wedding and I wasn't attending in person but based on the expected delivery date it should have arrived before she left so I was ok with that. I just found out after chatting with her a month later that she never received the gift. She contacted amazon as it was on her registry as purchased and was transferred a couple of times. As the purchaser, I contacted amazon to request a refund and have them re-issue a card and expedite shipping. They said sure, just go ahead and order the new one and I will refund your account right after. That made no sense to me but I was going to do it until going through the process I realized I needed to change the shipping address. Now I'm really angry because I have to look up the darn address again. Seconds later I was told, I can't issue the refund because it has to go through the gift card blah blah blah department and I would get a call back on Monday. At this point I'm irate and asked to speak to a supervisor. After a long hold I was told the supervisor approved a refund now but I can still go ahead and reorder. My response is that I'm not reordering anything until I get evidence that a refund is going to my credit card. This was an awful experience and I don't trust ordering gift cards from amazon again. I don't know what carrier was used but whatever disconnect happened between the shipping of the gift-card and the delivery is not my problem. I'm also disappointed that Amazon has no controls in place that would show an order has been in transit for so long. I should have noticed as well but I'm the customer and I want my ordering experience to be seamless.

Update:4/29 - my friend told me that someone drove to her home in their personal vehicle and hand delivered the gift card to her on Sunday which was the day after I complained. That was a good move but I'm still very disappointed in this service.

title: Avoid Buying Gift Card -- Activation and use problems, plus difficulty getting refund.
text:
My dad activated the card, obtained PIN, and attempted to use it at gas station pump. Unable to use it - "not valid" message.

August 13 Contacted gift card company about problem and they advised card can only be used at attendant terminal.

On August 14 attempted to use card at CVS cashier for $8.36 purchase. Advised only $0.01 available.

Contacted gift card company and they sent email showing fraudulent transactions. My dad completed forms and sent back. Dad just contacted me asking for purchase receipt.

All of this was a major hassle and turned out to be a terrible gift.

Bottom line. Gift card company sells $100 card. Waits for activation. Then after complaint, they provide this type email showing multiple transactions that are not realistic but amounts to $99.99. They then require extensive paperwork and phone information (name, address, phone) and indicate it will be 60-90 days for them to investigate with retail merchants on the transactions. After they complete actions they will then either provide new card or re-activate existing.

title: Poor Service
text: At approrxmately 1354 hours, 27 March 2019, I entered the Firehouse Subs in Kingstowne Tower Center, Kingstowne, VA. There were approximately six individuals in the establishment when I placed my order. I wanted a club on a sub with no raw onions, sauteed onions, and black olives. When the sandwich arrived, it had raw onions, no sauteed onions, and no black olives. I sent it back. Attempt number two had raw onions, no sauteed onions, and no black olives. This time I called for the manager. When he arrived, he asked how I was doing. I replied that I was browned off like a Cajun roux. He told me not to curse at him. A Cajun roux is a thickener used in New Orleans cooking made of flour and fat and cooked until it is brown. To be "browned off like a Cajun roux" is to be highly displeased. He wanted to have a third try. I agreed. He personally oversaw the sandwich's construction and had it served. This time, I had no raw onions,did have sauteed onions, but no black onions. I ate it anyway. The manager did comp my entire meal.
